name: The Black Shield
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Krog brings a blackened iron shield to a smith for answers. Reethe gave him nothing useful, leaving Mosarn as his only lead.

sections.title: A Smith's Name
sections.body: Krog remembers Mosarn as a highly regarded blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. The Earthen Ring once thanked Krog with armor Mosarn had crafted, and Krog speaks well of that work. He believes Mosarn made the shield too and may know more. It is a slim lead. Reethe yielded nothing useful, so Krog brings the blackened iron shield to Mosarn in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Mosarn's Word
sections.body: Mosarn confirms that he made the shield himself, but remembers little else. He has made so many shields and armor sets that he cannot recall them all.

faq.answer: Mosarn is a highly regarded blacksmith in Thunder Bluff. He crafted the armor the Earthen Ring gave Krog.

faq.q: Why take the shield to Mosarn?
faq.answer: Krog believes Mosarn made the shield and may know more about it. Reethe yielded nothing useful, so this slim lead is all Krog has.

aliases: how does krog know the smith
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring thanked Krog with armor crafted by Mosarn.

attribution: Classic quest text: The Black Shield
